newsitem.title: USA: Exsorbet to buy 1.2 mln of its APS stock.
newsitem.headline: Exsorbet to buy 1.2 mln of its APS stock.

text.p: Exsorbet Industries Inc said Tuesday it will buy back 1.2 million shares of its capital stock from American Physicians Service Group Inc, and also that APS relinquished its option to buy an additional 2 million shares of Exsorbet's capital stock.
Exsorbet said it will buy back the shares in exchange for an interest bearing note of $3.3 million. APS paid that amount when it bought the stock on September 30, 1996.
The note is due October 1, 1997, Exsorbet said. It is secured by the repurchased stock and all the outstanding stock of 7-7 Inc, the company added.
